title: Design System: SF Vibe Lab Donation Site

display.purpose: Campaign headline on the yellow wall, list headings ("Elige una campaña", "Campañas terminadas") and notice signs; uppercase, carries the painted shadow. Steps down to clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.75rem) from 960px.

headline-numeral.purpose: Raised amount in yellow on the añil band; tabular figures. 2.5rem from 960px; 2rem–2.75rem inside a campaign board tally.

headline-gap.purpose: "FALTAN $X", "Meta superada por $X" or "Faltaron $X" in cal on añil, close in size to the numeral. 1.75rem from 960px.

title.purpose: Uppercase section signs (Elige tu donativo, Para qué es, Gracias, Campaña cerrada) and campaign names on list boards. 1.25rem from 960px.

label-sign.purpose: The SF Vibe Lab · Mérida signature in the wall corner.

lead.purpose: Campaign purpose opening the story column; Lexend 700. The wall line uses Lexend 700 on phones and 400 from 960px.

body.purpose: All running text and supporter rows; story capped near 68ch.

small.purpose: Helper lines, donate notice, preview strip, footer and the tally goal/date lines.

shadows.name: painted-sombra
shadows.purpose: Flat two-coat sign-painter shadow on display lettering only. The system has no box shadows.

motion.name: brush-wipe
motion.purpose: Almagre coat wiped left to right onto the selected amount tile.

motion.name: sign-repaint
motion.purpose: Donate sign hover repaint (enamel to añil).

motion.name: board-sign-hover
motion.purpose: On an añil tally the "VER Y DONAR" sign repaints izamal with enamel lettering, since an añil hover would vanish.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition completes instantly.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Below this (max-width) amount tiles drop from 4 to 2 columns.

breakpoints.name: sheet
breakpoints.purpose: From this (min-width) the donation form is a centred 44rem sheet instead of the whole screen.

breakpoints.name: board
breakpoints.purpose: From this (min-width) a campaign board puts its tally coat beside the text and hangs it 0.75rem off the top right corner.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: From this (min-width) the campaign page splits into content plus a 360–420px sticky donate column on the yellow wall, and the whole site steps down to the tighter desktop scale.

lines.name: line
lines.purpose: Outline for tiles, donate board, meter (cal on añil), bill frame and the top of the thanks list.

focus.name: focus-default
focus.purpose: Default focus ring on cal and yellow grounds.

focus.name: focus-on-dark
focus.purpose: Focus ring on añil or enamel grounds (inside the band). The ring follows the ground it is drawn on, not the element.

components.name: Donate Sign
components.description: The loudest object after the headline: a full-width enamel slab lettered in yellow, repainting its amount. Also used as a link ("VER Y DONAR", "VER CAMPAÑAS ABIERTAS"). Steps down to 3.25rem tall from 960px.

narrative.overview:
The site is a hand-painted shop sign on a lime-washed Mérida wall. Whole sections are painted as flat walls of colour (Izamal yellow, añil blue, black enamel) on a cal ground, and the campaign is lettered across them in big sign-painter capitals. It is proud and plain-spoken: one campaign, what has been raised, what is still missing, an amount, a donate sign, and the names of the people who gave.

Everything is flat. There are no gradients, no blur, no rounded cards and no box shadows. Depth comes only from coats of paint overlapping: the añil band climbs onto the foot of the yellow wall, the cal donate board hangs on the yellow wall, the campaign photo is pasted on like a bill with an enamel frame. One colour, almagre red, is held back for the single thing in motion: the amount the donor has just chosen.

Density is low and the type is large, because most visitors are relatives on phones. Display lettering is loud; everything meant to be read sits in a calm, highly legible sans.
keyCharacteristics: Flat coats of colour as sections; depth only by overlap.
Sign-painter capitals (Bungee) for display, with a flat painted shadow on the headline only.
Lexend for all reading text, with a plain zero so amounts read as money.
Square corners and 2px enamel outlines everywhere.
Almagre red only on the selected or pressed element.
What is missing is lettered as boldly as what was raised.

rules.name: The One Moving Colour Rule
rules.body: Almagre appears only on the element in motion: the selected amount, a pressed sign, a selection, or a form error the donor has to fix. If nothing is chosen or wrong, nothing is red.

rules.name: The Flat Coat Rule
rules.body: Colour is applied as solid coats. No gradients, no transparency washes, no blur.

rules.name: The Readable Wall Rule
rules.body: Every text colour sits on a wall it was tested on: enamel or añil on yellow, cal or yellow on añil, yellow or cal on enamel, enamel through weather-3 on cal. Izamal never letters on cal.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bungee is for signs, never for sentences. Anything a donor has to read in full is Lexend.

rules.name: The Painted Shadow Rule
rules.body: The flat two-coat shadow (a cal coat, then an enamel coat) belongs to display lettering only. Titles, numerals and buttons are lettered without it.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount (numeral, tiles, supporter amounts, goal line) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: The añil band climbs 2rem onto the yellow wall and stops short of the right edge (0.75rem–2.5rem), so the cal ground shows beside it. Sections meet by overlapping coats, never by a gap with a divider.

rules.name: The Coats, Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: To raise something, paint it as a new coat over another wall; never lift it with a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Square Sign Rule
rules.body: No rounded corners and no pills, on anything.

dos: Do paint sections as whole flat walls (izamal, anil, enamel) on the cal ground.
Do keep almagre for the one chosen or pressed element (The One Moving Colour Rule).
Do letter the missing amount as boldly as the raised one.
Do outline tiles, boards and frames with the 2px enamel line and keep every corner square.
Do use Lexend with tabular figures for every amount a donor reads.
Do keep touch targets large: tiles at least 3.25rem, the donate sign at least 3.75rem.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pill buttons, gradients, blur or box shadows.
Don't put the painted shadow on anything other than display lettering.
Don't use almagre for decoration, headings or static emphasis.
Don't letter izamal on the cal ground; it fails contrast.
